sections.text_helper: Section 31.6.28 "TIM alternate function register 2 (TIM_AF2)" in chapter 31 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1/TIM8)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1115.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x064
Reset value: 0x0000 0001
Bit 31 BK2CMP20E: tim_brk2_cmp20 enable
This bit enables the tim_brk2_cmp20 for the timer’s tim_brk2 input. tim_brk2_cmp20 output
is ‘ORed’ with the other tim_brk2 sources.
0: tim_brk2_cmp20 input disabled
1: tim_brk2_cmp20 input enabled
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).

Bits 19:16 OCRSEL[3:0]: ocref_clr source selection
These bits select the ocref_clr input source.
0000:tim_ocref_clr0
0001:tim_ocref_clr1
...
1111:tim_ocref_clr15
Refer to Section31.3.2: TIM1/TIM8 pins and internal signals for product specific information.
Note: These bits can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK
bits in TIM_BDTR register).
Bits 15:14 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 13 BK2CMP4P: tim_brk2_cmp4 input polarity
This bit selects the tim_brk2_cmp4 input sensitivity. It must be programmed together with the
BK2P polarity bit.
0:tim_brk2_cmp4 input polarity is not inverted (active low if BK2P=0, active high if
BK2P=1)
1:tim_brk2_cmp4 input polarity is inverted (active high if BK2P=0, active low if BK2P=1)
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
